subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Youth is the time when __the seeds of character is sown.__

options.text: the seeds of character will have been sowing
the seeds of character had been sown
the seeds of character were sown
the seeds of character are sown

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the plural form of the verb 'are' is correct.
 
• The subject **'seeds'** is **plural**, so the verb should also be in the plural form.
 
• Therefore, the plural form of the verb 'are' is the correct choice.

Hence, the correct statement is "*Youth **is **the time when the seeds of character **are sown**."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If the **subject is singular**, the verb should also be in its **singular form**.

 
 
• **Example:** *The **seed is** sown in the spring.*
 
 
 
• If the **subject is plural**, the verb should be in its **plural form**.
 
 
• Example: *The **seeds are** sown in the spring.*
